title: igni deployment theme
description: A deployment's theme.json: colour and other tokens, icon drawings and brand, never behaviour. The design is docs/UI_FLOOR.md §4; igni does not load a theme file yet, so this fixes the format ahead of the loader. Point your editor at it with "$schema": "https://ignite-ember.sh/schema/theme-1.json".

name.description: The theme's name, as a person sees it.

extends.description: The shipped base theme this one starts from.

tokens.description: Token values by colour scheme. A token is a published CSS custom property (`--bg`, `--accent-blue`, ...); a value is a CSS value.

icons.description: A different drawing for a published icon name. Path data only, never SVG markup (UI_FLOOR.md §4.3): igni renders it inside its own <svg>.

wordmark.description: Path to an image, relative to the theme file.
